parameter.name: RATE_TOL_REL_DB
parameter.what: the dB family's relative term -- one of the five per-unit scalars the pre-#782 scalar RATE_TOL_REL split into. A relative tolerance is dimensionally meaningless on an offset scale: RATE_TOL_REL x |-80 dB| handed a cqt bin sitting at the floor_db clamp 9.6 dB of licence at 0.12 and 1.6 dB at 0.02 -- the licence grows with the bin's distance from 0 dB, which for a dB column is backwards -- and 7.0 dB of real 44.1k<->48k movement sat under the old licence at 440 Hz (#775's committed limits name exactly this repair and file it as #782). Registered with the proposal (#782), before the sweep ran. The other four units' terms (RATE_TOL_REL_PPM/MS/COUNT/RATIO) are held at their shipped 0.02 by the instrument's per-unit override, which merges over the shipped dict; the ratio family's term is registered separately by rate-tol-rel.json, whose grid this record deliberately does not reuse because a scalar grid moved all five units together.

objective.name: pairs the control catches on the integer fold
objective.why: the dial's job is how much real 44.1k<->48k dependence the rate-independence control can SEE in the family it governs, so the objective is that, counted on the honest injected defect rather than on a synthetic perturbation: the integer-lag fold that shipped before #767, which test_the_integer_fold_this_replaced_is_still_red_on_this_panel already uses as its control, through rate_tolerance itself with the dB term overridden per-unit. Counted as (panel entry, column) pairs over tolerance across the wide panel. It is deliberately NOT the only thing the dial trades: the count falls as the licence grows, so on this objective alone the smallest value wins, and the cost columns in the same artefact -- clean-fold pairs going red, split by unit, plus the shipped-panel count that decides quarantine retirement -- are the constraint from the other side. jit.* columns are excluded on any entry where dominant_period disagrees between the rates by more than 5 % (#774), as in #775's sweep.

range_basis: 0.02 is the value the dB term carries until this change; on the grid so the record prices the CHANGE and not only the dial.
0.12 is the scalar that shipped until #775, under which the 7.0 dB null movement at 440 Hz sat hidden; it prices the top of the range.

0.00625 = RATE_TOL_ABS['db'] / 80 dB: at the floor_db clamp the relative term equals the 0.5 dB floor exactly, so at this value and below the dial is inert for every dB column. Paired with 0.0, which removes the term outright.
0.057 sits above the committed RATE_KNOWN_RED crossings of the two smaller null families (cqt4064Hz 4.07/80 = 0.0509, cqt2874Hz 4.43/80 = 0.0554): the decision row for 'the smaller nulls pass'.
0.09 sits above the worst committed cqt3225Hz bound (7.00/80 = 0.0875) with 2.9 % of margin: the decision row for 'every quarantined cqt null passes'.

0.1 is the headroom row, 14 % above the worst committed bound -- the ship candidate if 2.9 % is judged too thin against cross-version gap noise. Both 0.09 and 0.1 retire the same ten entries; the objective prices what the extra licence costs.
grid.held_fixed: the other four relative terms at their shipped 0.02 (held by the override's merge, not by promise), RATE_TOL_ABS's five floors, FOLD_SINC_TAPS at its shipped 16 for the cost panel and -1 for the benefit panel, and the stimulus panel itself

decision_rule.why: the objective is an INTEGER COUNT of (entry, column) pairs. Two counts are equal or they are not; there is no 'within' for a count, so the rule has to be exact equality. The wide panel is at most 92 entries x 191 columns = 17572 pairs, so any relative tolerance below 1/17572 = 5.7e-5 is exact equality by construction, and 1e-5 is below that with a factor of 5.7 to spare. Stated from the objective's own granularity and the panel's size, both known before the sweep ran, and not from the spread of the data.

evidence.instrument: rate_tolerance itself, through its per-unit dict override -- the shipped comparison, called and not restated. tools/probes/test_rate_tol_sweep.py asserts that the instrument's re-evaluated reds are the SAME (entry, column) pairs _rate_gaps(tol_rel={...}) returns on the shipped panel, for the per-unit overrides as well as the scalars, so the re-evaluation cannot drift from the comparison the test applies; it also asserts a per-unit override leaves the other units' tolerances at their shipped terms and refuses an unknown unit key. Stimuli are the module's own _square, _bl_square and band-limited _resample, so the rate pair is the one the rate-independence test compares. Each panel entry asserts its own preconditions through _rate_pair (a jittered entry really carries jitter, a band-limited entry really is fractional at both rates) and an AssertionError there REFUSES the whole sweep.

prediction.basis: Derived from the max() arithmetic, the module's own magnitude ceilings, and #775's committed artefact -- none of which is a point on this sweep. Committed in docs/sensitivity/rate-tol-rel-by-unit-plan.json before the instrument was run, which the instrument's own refusal on an uncommitted or dirty plan makes checkable. (a) MONOTONE: raising the dB term can only raise a dB pair's tolerance, so caught and caught_db are non-increasing in the dial and every group is an interval; the other four units' counts cannot move at all. (b) [0.0, 0.00625] is ONE group: for every dB pair peak <= 80 (the floor_db clamp), rel * peak <= 0.5 = RATE_TOL_ABS['db'], so the tolerance equals the floor for every dB column at both points -- the dial is inert below 0.00625. (c) 0.02 separates: #775's committed cost-by-unit table shows dB pairs with clean-fold crossings throughout (0.00625, 0.02] -- 15 in (0.00625, 0.0146] and 11 in (0.0146, 0.02] -- and the integer fold's dB gaps on the same stimuli are at least as large, so the injected fold has crossings there too. (d) 0.057, 0.09, 0.1, 0.12 each separate: #775's committed counts put 91 dB clean-fold pairs' crossings in (0.02, 0.12] spread across the interval, its reach table names cqt null crossings at 0.081-0.0895, and the integer fold shifts crossings up rather than down. MIXED, 6 groups over 7 points.
